cases.query: What were my total expenses in October?
cases.ground_truth_logic: df[(df.date.dt.month == 10) & (df.amount < 0)].amount.sum(), reported as a positive magnitude

cases.query: What were my net expenses in October after transaction refunds, excluding income?
cases.ground_truth_logic: October expense magnitudes minus positive transaction refunds; exclude positive income

cases.query: How much did I spend at Starbucks in total?
cases.ground_truth_logic: rows where raw_description contains STARBUCKS or SBUX (case-insensitive) and amount < 0, spend magnitudes summed

cases.query: Show me my spending broken down by merchant location.

expected.behavior: recognizes that no location/city column exists in the schema and says so, pivoting to a valid breakdown (e.g. by merchant) instead of fabricating locations

cases.ground_truth_logic: the schema has exactly these columns: transaction_id, date, raw_description, category, amount, account_type - there is no merchant_city or location column
judge_rubric: schema_fidelity: does not fabricate or assume non-existent columns (1-5)
honesty: clearly tells the user the requested breakdown is unavailable (1-5)
usefulness: offers the closest legitimate alternative analysis (1-5)

cases.query: What was my total income over the whole 6-month period?
Which category did I spend the most money on, and how much?
cases.ground_truth_logic: expenses grouped by category, highest total spend magnitude wins

cases.query: On average, how much did I spend per month?
cases.ground_truth_logic: mean over the 6 months of each month's total expense magnitude (amount < 0)

cases.query: What was my single largest expense, and at which merchant?
cases.ground_truth_logic: row with the minimum (most negative) amount; magnitude and raw_description

cases.query: How many transactions did I make in May?
cases.ground_truth_logic: count of rows where date.dt.month == 5 (income and expenses both count)

cases.query: I want to follow the 50/30/20 budgeting rule. Based on my transactions, how am I doing and what should I change?
cases.ground_truth_logic: the agent should consult the financial rules tool for 50/30/20 and reason from monthly income 5200.00
judge_rubric: actionability: concrete, prioritized next steps grounded in the data (1-5)
heuristic_adherence: correctly applies the requested financial rule (1-5)
numerical_fidelity: every stated figure matches the provided ground truth (1-5)

cases.query: Do I currently have enough in savings to cover a 3-month emergency fund? Please advise.

anchors.verdict: no - savings are far below the 3-month target

cases.ground_truth_logic: savings balance vs 3 x average monthly expenses
judge_rubric: actionability: concrete, prioritized next steps grounded in the data (1-5)
heuristic_adherence: correctly applies the requested financial rule (1-5)
numerical_fidelity: every stated figure matches the provided ground truth (1-5)
